mapper.select: SELECT id, provider, model, api_key_encrypted, meta, priority, enabled, created_at FROM model_configs
SELECT id, provider, model, api_key_encrypted, meta, priority, enabled, created_at FROM model_configs WHERE enabled = 1 ORDER BY priority ASC
SELECT id, provider, model, api_key_encrypted, meta, priority, enabled, created_at FROM model_configs WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO model_configs (provider, model, api_key_encrypted, meta, priority, enabled, created_at) VALUES (#{provider}, #{model}, #{apiKeyEncrypted}, #{metaJson}, #{priority}, #{enabled}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE model_configs SET provider=#{provider}, model=#{model}, api_key_encrypted=#{apiKeyEncrypted}, meta=#{metaJson}, priority=#{priority}, enabled=#{enabled}, updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{id}
